:::: {.home-biography}

I am a PhD student in Finance at the University of Luxembourg. My research focuses on the development of residual-based theory and statistical methods for structural break detection in nonstationary multivariate time series models.

## Main research fields

Time Series Econometrics, Mathematical Statistics, Financial Econometrics, and Asymptotic Theory.

::::

:::: {.home-details}

## Education

- PhD in Finance (ongoing), [University of Luxembourg](https://www.uni.lu/en/).
- M.Sc. in Quantitative Economics and Finance, [University of Luxembourg](https://www.uni.lu/en/).
- Master's in Mathematical Sciences, [African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS)](https://aims-cameroon.org/).
- Master's in Applied Mathematics (Probability, Statistics and Finance), [University of Yaoundé I](https://uy1.uninet.cm/).
- Bachelor's in Applied Mathematics, [University of Dschang](https://www.univ-dschang.org/).

## Honours and awards

- [Economist Club Luxembourg Award](https://www.uni.lu/fdef-en/news/recognising-achievement-and-partnership-at-fdefs-2025-partnership-event/) (2025), co-recipient.
- ABBL Foundation Scholarship (2024–2025).
- Prof. Marco Garuti Award (2024), best female student and second overall.
- Winner of the Three Minutes Thesis Competition (2024).
- Mastercard Foundation Scholarship (2023–2024).
- Excellence Award, President of the Republic of Cameroon (2020, 2021 and 2022).
- JESAM Excellence Award (2018).
